records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased in all of our end markets compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Overall unit shipments increased by 28% and average sales prices increased by approximately 17% compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The significant components of our working capital are cash and cash equivalents, short-term investments, accounts receivable, inventories and other current assets, reduced by accounts payable, accrued compensation and related benefits, and other accrued liabilities.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: To date, we have not experienced any material information security breaches or incurred significant operating expenses related to information security breaches.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2021, net cash provided by operating activities was $77.1 million, primarily due to our net income adjusted for certain non-cash items, including depreciation and amortization and stock-based compensation, and a net decrease of $3.1 million from the changes in our operating assets and liabilities.
